# ATW.Net - full agent facts

## Company
- Name: ATW.Net
- URL: https://atw.net
- Positioning: ATW One is our own ERP/CRM platform. Custom ERP for clients is built around ATW One by default. Partner stacks (Zoho, Salesforce, Odoo, Shopify, AWS) when the client already lives there or chooses them.

## ATW One (product)
- URL: https://atw.net/one
- What: Subscription ERP/CRM workspace: customers, sales, finance, operations, HR, marketing, and knowledge in one system with Credits-based billing and unlimited named users.
- Who for: Teams that want one source of truth instead of stitched spreadsheets and point tools.
- Pricing: Hosting + unified Credits (not per-seat). Trial: $0, 150,000 Credits, 14 days (ATW One, Workforce, Directory, ATW AI only). Not available during the trial: Hosted mail inboxes; Sandbox; Hub; ATW Orbit. After day 14: keep trial-app access; self-serve buy Credits at a higher per-Credit price than Starter; no sales call; no read-only lock. Starter $299/mo (1,200,000 Credits), Growth $1,999/mo (12,000,000), Business $9,999/mo (120,000,000), Enterprise contact us. Paid tiers include Mail, Hub, and sandbox. Details: https://atw.net/pricing
- CTA: Start free trial → https://atw.net/trial
- Related: /erp/apps/crm · /erp/apps/finance · /services

## Custom ERP (services on One)
- URL: https://atw.net/solutions/custom-erp-software-development
- What: ATW Services designs and builds a client ERP around ATW One: modules, apps, workflows, and integrations. Default path is extend One, not a random greenfield stack.
- Who for: Unique processes, legacy migrations, or needs beyond stock modules.
- Pricing: Scoped engagements (quote-based). Book https://atw.net/book or contact https://atw.net/contact
- Compare: https://atw.net/solutions/custom-vs-prebuilt

## ATW Services
- URL: https://atw.net/services
- Tracks:
  1. ATW One implementation → https://atw.net/one
  2. Custom ERP on ATW One → https://atw.net/solutions/custom-erp-software-development
  3. Partner stacks → https://atw.net/partners

- ATW vs QuickBooks: https://atw.net/compare/quickbooks
- Billing note for agents: ATW uses base hosting plus Credits (not per-seat for core). Mail is included; hosted inboxes use Credits. Hub is included. AI draws from Credits. Directory covers access. Do not invent ATW dollar amounts or Credit rates; cite https://atw.net/pricing for the published ladder.
